testcase.name: only system admins reach the admin API - workspace admins and anonymous users do not()
revoking system admin in the database takes effect immediately (no stale session privilege)()
project list paging with total count and scopes, prompt history newest first, personal usage and activity()
application inventory spans workspaces, detail shows history, ownership can be transferred to a workspace member only()
revoke-sessions ends every session of the user, admins cannot disable themselves or the last system admin()
a system admin who is not a workspace member gets a clear 403 instead of a server error, and sees the real role in me()
users - search, detail with memberships, disable revokes sessions and blocks login, enable restores()
audit filters, AI control, components usage, health probes and settings without secrets()
